verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents an Editor API for automating asset management (docs-30, docs-9) and lists REST API access (docs-27). SplatTransform is an official CLI for converting, filtering and merging splat assets (docs-22), and a community comment points to playcanvas-sync for mapping project assets to the local file system (comm-10). None of this shows import-time hooks or import presets, so automated processing of incoming assets is only implied. missing for 10: documented import hooks/post-processors, import presets/settings templates, a batch-import pipeline for general assets (models/textures) beyond splats, hands-on corroboration.
